name: AL-Naqawa
description: Web prayer-time tools and a public beta MCP service for compatible AI clients.
interpretation: Calculated prayer starts, not mosque Iqamah or Jumuah schedules.
Calendar labels are planning calculations, not local moon-sighting announcements.
Qibla is an initial true-north bearing, not a live sensor compass.
Timetable generation does not set alarms or import calendar events.
Published city coverage is incomplete; confirm location through search.
verification_scope: Product statements follow the current public sources; six read-only example requests were checked. No independent astronomical accuracy study was performed.
